FX-RPULSE-001.says: The settings as they start: Pulse Level 0 and never keyed, so there is no ring: the drawing, untouched.

FX-RPULSE-002.says: A drop: the level held at 0 until frame 1, then 10, Time Span 0.25 seconds (6 frames), Amplitude 2: frame 0 nothing; at frame 1 the middle pushed out 2 pixels; then a ring 2 pixels strong running outward, half way to the corners by frame 4.

FX-RPULSE-003.says: The same drop downward, 0 to -10: the ring draws the picture in.

FX-RPULSE-004.says: The level rising steadily from 0 at frame 0 to 20 at frame 4: a pulse of 5 a frame, a growing disc pushed out a pixel.

FX-RPULSE-005.says: FX-RPULSE-002 centred at the left quarter, 25, 50.

FX-RPULSE-006.says: FX-RPULSE-002 with Render Bump Map on: grey heights instead, the middle at 0.51 and the ring's slope down to 0.5 at frame 4.

FX-RPULSE-007.says: FX-RPULSE-002 with Time Span 0: no history, so no ring.

FX-RPULSE-008.says: FX-RPULSE-002 with Time Span 1 second (24 frames): the ring runs four times slower, still near the middle at frame 4.

FX-RPULSE-009.says: FX-RPULSE-002 with the layer moved three pixels right: the same, moved; nothing grows.

FX-RPULSE-010.says: FX-RPULSE-002 with Amplitude 0: the drawing, untouched.

FX-RPULSE-011.says: The level eased from 0 at frame 0 to 1000 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots, Amplitude 0.01, Time Span 0.25: the level is held at 1000 before the history is read, so frame 4 is the history 0, ..., 1000, 1000.

FX-RPULSE-012.says: FX-RPULSE-006's bump map with Amplitude 200: the middle's grey held at white.

FX-RPULSE-013.says: Pulse Level 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RPULSE-014.says: Time Span 11, above 10 seconds. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RPULSE-015.says: Time Span -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RPULSE-016.says: Amplitude 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RPULSE-017.says: Render Bump Map "yes", not a word it takes. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RPULSE-018.says: Centre at 50, 1001, past ten heights. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RPULSE-019.says: Pulse Level keyed to -2000 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
